title: Emotiv + IoT + Mobile — Device Fleet & Online/Offline Handling
note: Device connectivity model. online=live stream; offline=buffer+sync. status: built/partial/planned.

connectivity_model.online: Device streams live → gateway → backend (real-time inference + alerts). Lowest latency, needs connection.
connectivity_model.offline: Device buffers locally (ring buffer + local store) → syncs on reconnect. No data loss; delayed inference.
connectivity_model.hybrid: Edge inference on-device (offline-capable) + sync raw + results when online. Best for seizure alerts.

devices.name: Smartwatch (Apple/Wear OS)
devices.offline: watch buffers → sync when phone connects

devices.name: Patient Mobile App
devices.offline: local SQLite → queue → sync on reconnect (offline-first)

offline_strategy.buffer: Ring buffer on device (last N minutes) + persistent local store (SQLite/flash)
offline_strategy.edge_inference: On-device seizure model runs offline → alert fires without cloud
offline_strategy.sync: On reconnect: upload buffered raw + results, dedupe by event timestamp/idempotency key
offline_strategy.conflict: Last-write-wins on metadata; events are append-only (no conflict)
offline_strategy.data_loss: Zero — buffer persists across power cycles; sync is at-least-once + idempotent

alert_pipeline: device → (edge model OR gateway) → confidence gate → SOS (phone/SMS/caregiver) → audit

summary.honest_note: Connectivity model + fleet designed; live device integration is simulated. Real Emotiv SDK / BLE / mobile apps require hardware + native app builds.
